payload.summary: The longer experiment completed four matched pairs and 72 scheduled fresh Codex turns, including eight intentional process interruptions, actual revisions and parallel worktrees. Both arms passed 120/120 primary functional cases, 52/52 exact intent checks and 9,216/9,216 exploratory stress checks. No primary quality advantage was observed against an explicitly instructed Markdown baseline. All 72 snapshots and 18,432 stress checks replayed independently. Actual scope refusals were observed; the induced shared-file merge conflict remained in all four projects per arm. Authentication copies were removed. Full publication and cross-platform CI are being finalized.
payload.next: Natural default-agent workflows, multi-day and multi-domain field studies, real desktop/Claude runs and independent duplicate-effort scoring remain open.
